news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.5% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.4x net interest cover). Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (7.5% average weekly change). Large one-off items

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.52 (vs ₹0.05 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.52 (up from ₹0.05 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹3.25b (up 34% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹118.3m (up ₹107.2m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.6% (up from 0.5% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 24% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 20% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹0.38 loss per share (down from ₹0.42 profit in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹3.57b (up 34% from 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹86.2m (down 192% from profit in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 16% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 24% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
